summary: Iteration 17 (15:34 Vapi call, exact quote rules). test_exact_quote.py 5/5 pass. Of the 30 older failing tests listed by E1, 26 were obsolete and have been rewritten to the NEW RULES (keeping their original intent). 4 still fail on purpose because they are REAL regressions (3 root causes, details below). Three more tests outside the list were also obsolete and were rewritten: quote_pdf_unit (range in the PDF), round2 test_quote_pdf_content ('Likely range'), vapi_call_link (the backstop now sets quote_generated). The same 9 files, run serially: 98 pass, 4 fail (the regressions). Also found: a 500 when a free-text answer lands on a qty fact, 'not sure' re-asking the same question, and a doubled assumption suffix. UI: the portal quote screen shows one total plus quote-if-not, and the dashboard Quotes page loads. But QuotesPage, QuoteDetail, LeadDrawer, OnCallCard, the live EstimateCard and the voice scripts still render a range, which now reads '$11,840 to $11,840'.

real_regressions_first.input: new Bathroom lead, update_scope/turn said='hi, can you hear me?' (or said='' answers={}), wants_price=False
real_regressions_first.output: status ok, total $22,450, line 'Bathroom remodel, standard finish, medium size (assumed)'. A price nobody asked for at the greeting. Via Vapi update_scope this also saves a quote.
real_regressions_first.location: engine.turn(): next_action() returns 'price' when there is nothing open (no items), then lines 827-830 add PACKAGES[...] with no check for wants_price. The package should only be used when wants_price, the call-end backstop, or done-words apply. Otherwise ask 'What work would you like done?'

real_regressions_first.input: custom-only scope ('put in a small koi pond'). The facts are answered, so a price is given: placeholder 'Remodel project, standard finish, medium size (assumed)' $15,000. Then the contractor prices the custom line (POST /itemizer/{lid}/items/{iid}/price tiers [4000,6000,9000]).
real_regressions_first.output: new quote total 21450 = 6000 koi + 15000 placeholder package + 450. The assumed package stays on the quote after real work is priced (expected 6450).
real_regressions_first.location: engine.turn() lines 828-830 store the package as a permanent session item (basis 'assumed'). price_custom() (line ~992) and any later turn that adds priced work never remove it. Fix: drop items with basis 'assumed' and task in PACKAGES once priced_items() has any other item, or keep the package out of s['items'] and only add it at price time.

real_regressions_first.input: said='And removing the mirrors and replacing it with something that has LED lights in the mirror.'
real_regressions_first.output: new_items = ['Lighted (LED) mirror', 'Exhaust fan and lights', 'Hardwired electrical line for the mirror']. 'Exhaust fan and lights' should not be there (double electrical; the word 'lights' triggers the exhaust/lights job). Also said='I want something warmer on the shower walls, retile them.' gives ['Walk-in shower', 'Shower wall retile'], which breaks the rule 'Shower wall retile (not Walk-in shower)'. And 'Want to replace this with something a little bit more warm' becomes a 'To be priced by Apex' custom line, although it describes the tile.
real_regressions_first.location: kb.py KB_VERSION 5 triggers for the exhaust_fan/lights task and walk_in_shower. engine.match_tasks/overlap_drops should let lighted_mirror absorb 'lights' and shower_retile absorb 'shower walls'. unmatched_clauses() WORK_WORDS matches 'replace ... warm'.

real_regressions_first.input: Half bath: answers {'new_vanity_sinks': 'no'}, then the turn that reaches the price
real_regressions_first.output: HTTP 500 ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'no' at engine.price() line 569 (qty = float(self.value(c['qty']))). A Vapi tool call would error.
real_regressions_first.location: engine.apply_answers() line 400: a non-numeric fact whose options are ['1','2'] stores free text from normalize() (returns raw t). Validate against the options (else treat it as unknown/assumed), or guard the float() in price().

real_regressions_first.test: test_call_fixes::test_p0_single_not_sure_reasks and test_itemizer_fixes::test_not_sure_advances_immediately (both still PASS but encode the OLD behaviour)
real_regressions_first.input: 'I want this sink gone', then answers {'replacing_vanity': 'not sure'}
real_regressions_first.output: The same question 'Are you putting a new vanity there, or leaving the space open?' is asked again word for word. This breaks rule 2 ('each fact asked at most once'; declined/unknown means assumed immediately). It is the 15:34 loop pattern when Alex sends 'not sure' as an answer instead of skipped.
real_regressions_first.location: engine.apply_answers() lines 385-393 (the p0 unknowns counter needs 2). It should call assume(f) on the first UNKNOWN. After the fix, update those 2 tests.

critical.issue: R1: an empty scope is priced as a $22,450 package without any price request
R2: the placeholder package stays after the custom line is priced (+$15,000)
R4: 500 when a free-text answer lands on a qty fact (new_vanity_sinks='no')

minor.issue: Doubled suffix: 'Assumed fan vents outside: yes (confirmed at the site visit) (assumed, to confirm at the site visit)'. The site_visit branch of note() plus the suffix added in price() line 594.
R3: 'LED lights in the mirror' adds Exhaust fan and lights; 'shower walls ... retile' adds Walk-in shower; a descriptive 'something more warm' becomes a custom line
R5: 'not sure' in answers re-asks the same must-ask once

Not atomic. A turn running at the same time got KeyError 'floor_area' in p0_open() (engine.py:294) and returned 500 during a parallel pytest run (xdist -n 2). Old fixtures in test_itemizer/test_call_fixes/test_itemizer_fixes call /kb/reset in teardown.

ui_bugs.component: shared/format.js range() used by QuotesPage 'Range' column, QuoteDetail subtitle, LeadDrawer, OnCallCard, portal EstimateCard (data-testid=estimate-range)
ui_bugs.issue: New quotes render '$11,840 to $11,840'. Rule 1 says one exact number, no range in the portal/UI. Show money(q.total) and drop the Range column.
Alex is given 'Version N, $X to $X' as the current_quote variable and in mock scripts. Should be the exact total.

fix12_insights_once (vapi mode: the poll returns [], update_scope returns the insight once, prepended to next_text)
test_itemizer.py: gate3_ask_when_camera_off, gate3_neither_assume, gate3_camera_answers..., gate6_deterministic, kb_get_and_edit_affects_price: the work is said first, then the answers (rule 3); no range; assumed suffix
test_itemizer_fixes.py: goal_after_price_new_version, dedupe_assumption_change_new_version, vapi_goal_then_update_scope_same_version, water_damage_assumption: opening split
test_open_ended.py: end_call_without_priced_quote_is_pending (backstop saves a quote and one WhatsApp)

action_items: R1: only use the standard package when a price is needed (wants_price, done-words, call-end backstop). Otherwise ask 'What work would you like done?'
R2: remove the assumed placeholder package once any real priced item (incl. a custom line priced from the dashboard) exists
R4: validate categorical answers against options and guard float(qty) in price(), so turn/update_scope never returns 500
R3: KB 5 triggers: LED mirror must not add Exhaust fan and lights; shower-wall retile must not add Walk-in shower; don't create a custom line from descriptive clauses
R5: 'not sure'/unknown answer -> assume immediately (apply_answers lines 385-393), then update test_p0_single_not_sure_reasks / test_not_sure_advances_immediately
Fix the doubled '(confirmed at the site visit) (assumed, to confirm at the site visit)' assumption text
Frontend: replace range() with the exact total in QuotesPage/QuoteDetail/LeadDrawer/OnCallCard/EstimateCard and in the voice rangeOf/current_quote
critical_code_review_comments: engine.py is 1017 lines (over 700). Split pricing/insights/turn into modules.

on_goal_result() and price_custom() still gate saving on iz.ready() (no open must-asks). That contradicts 'every open fact takes its default' and can leave a camera finding or a dashboard price without a new version while a must-ask is open.

Rule 3 ('a turn with answers creates no items from said'): an opening such as 'I want a new tile floor' + answers {finish_level} drops the work entirely. Together with R1 it becomes a $22,450 package. Consider creating items when none of the answer keys match an open fact.
ensure_quote() reprices with camera_on=False and wants_price=True, which is fine, but it runs the full turn() (claims insights and writes a log entry) at call end.

success_rate.backend: 96% (98/102 in the 9 itemizer/quote files, serial; the 4 failures are real regressions)
success_rate.frontend: Portal quote screen and Quotes page load and are correct apart from the redundant 'X to X' range text
